summary: US CENTCOM conducted extensive strikes on Iranian air defense, radar, missile, drone, and boat targets across the Hormuz Strait region on July 12. Iran's IRGC responded with missile and drone waves targeting US bases in Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman, and Jordan, claiming destruction of two HIMARS launchers in Kuwait. Reciprocal strikes continue with explosions reported across southern Iran and Gulf states.
key_points: US CENTCOM struck dozens of Iranian targets including air defense systems, coastal radar, missile and drone capabilities, and small boats in the Hormuz Strait on July 12. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82636)

IRGC launched retaliatory missile and drone waves at US bases across the Gulf, claiming hits on Al Udeid in Qatar and destruction of two HIMARS launchers in Kuwait. (Source: @VahidOnline/76956, @presstv/198448)
Explosions and air raid sirens activated in Bahrain amid reported Iranian projectile fire toward Gulf states. (Source: @asafroz/51349, @shin_persian/7754)

US strikes hit at least eight cities in Iran's Khuzestan province, including Andimeshk, Ahvaz, Omidiyeh, and Agajari airport. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376784, @shin_persian/7748, @rodast_omiddana/75853)
Iranian Shahed drones en route to designated US base targets as part of ongoing retaliatory operation. (Source: @presstv/198460)
IRGC says only end to US intervention in Hormuz Strait will reopen it to shipping. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376788)
Israeli strike hit a weapons manufacturing site in Gaza City. (Source: @amitsegal/62979)
Syrian parliament convened for first time since Assad's fall; Iraqi PM travels to Washington for energy talks. (Source: @asafroz/51353, @SharghDaily/171576)

sections.executive_summary: US CENTCOM conducted extensive strikes on Iranian air defense, radar, missile, drone, and boat targets across the Hormuz Strait region on July 12. Iran's IRGC responded with missile and drone waves targeting US bases in Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman, and Jordan, claiming destruction of two HIMARS launchers in Kuwait. Reciprocal strikes continue with explosions reported across southern Iran and Gulf states.

points: US CENTCOM conducted a new wave of offensive strikes against Iran on July 12, targeting dozens of sites across multiple areas with precision munitions to degrade Iran's ability to attack shipping in the Hormuz Strait, including Iranian military air defense systems, coastal radar sites, missile and drone capabilities, and small boats, using US fighter jets, warships, and one-way attack drones. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82636)

At least eight cities in Khuzestan province came under US attack early morning, including Andimeshk struck by projectiles at 0200 local time, Ahvaz where IRGC Miyankooh logistics deputy Maziyar Bobardak was targeted, Omidiyeh airport (Agajari) hit with new video footage emerging, and Agajari airport also struck. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376784, @shin_persian/7748, @shin_persian/7742, @rodast_omiddana/75853, @rodast_omiddana/75852)

Explosions reported in Bandar Abbas, Qeshm island, and Hormuz Strait area; additional strikes hit Chabahar, Minab, and Sirik in Sistan and Baluchestan province. (Source: @asafroz/51340, @inon_yttach/9402, @inon_yttach/9401)

IRGC claims simultaneous strikes on US bases and military assets in Oman, Qatar, Jordan, Kuwait, and Bahrain, with Shahed drones en route to designated targets as part of ongoing retaliatory operation. (Source: @VahidOnline/76956, @presstv/198460)

Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman states strikes on US bases constitute legitimate self-defense under international law; Iran threatens unprecedented retaliatory blows if US continues aggression. (Source: @presstv/198452, @yediotnews25/132578)
Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov made sudden visit to Tehran minutes before his plane landed, signaling high-level diplomatic engagement amid escalation. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75863)
IDF struck a weapons manufacturing site in Gaza City, with smoke rising over the city. (Source: @amitsegal/62979)
Shin Bet chief David Zini met opposition leader Yair Lapid for first security briefing since Zini's appointment. (Source: @inon_yttach/9393, @yediotnews25/132572)
IDF released 34-day fighting timeline and first order documentation marking 20 years since Second Lebanon War. (Source: @idf_telegram/24605)
Israeli airstrike targeted a weapons manufacturing site in Gaza City, producing visible smoke plumes. (Source: @amitsegal/62979)
Hostile drone overflight reported in Dahiyeh (Beirut southern suburbs) with maximum alert advised. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376791)
Artillery shelling hit Kfar Tibnit in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/31029)
Syrian parliament convened for first time since fall of Assad regime. (Source: @asafroz/51353)

Iraqi Prime Minister Al-Falih Al-Zidi departed for Washington leading governmental and economic delegation to sign MoUs on oil, gas, US company entry for energy upgrades, and corridors to reduce Hormuz Strait impact. (Source: @SharghDaily/171576)
Bahrain activated air raid sirens twice in recent hours; citizens instructed to seek shelter and follow official channels. (Source: @asafroz/51349, @shin_persian/7754, @N12chat/217134)

Explosions reported in Kuwait; IRGC claims destruction of two US HIMARS launchers and missile depots there; US military denies American casualties in Kuwait. (Source: @yediotnews25/132566, @inon_yttach/9387, @presstv/198448, @inon_yttach/9395)
IRGC claims strikes on Al Udeid base in Qatar and targets in Oman and Jordan; Qatar and Oman had been mediating between Iran and US. (Source: @VahidOnline/76956)
At least 13 US tanker aircraft active in region, 9 with transponders on, indicating high aerial refueling tempo. (Source: @kianmeli1/88899)

sections.threat_assessment: The reciprocal US-Iran strike cycle has expanded to direct targeting of Iranian air defense architecture and IRGC leadership elements in Khuzestan, while Iranian retaliation now systematically threatens US basing across the Gulf Cooperation Council states. The involvement of mediators Qatar and Oman as target sets signals erosion of diplomatic off-ramps. Israeli operations in Gaza continue but remain secondary to the dominant US-Iran confrontation.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are absorbing direct Iranian fire (Bahrain, Kuwait) and hosting US assets under attack, creating pressure for collective defense coordination. Iraq's prime ministerial visit to Washington seeks energy alternatives to Hormuz transit, reflecting regional hedging. Russia's Lavrov visit to Tehran indicates great-power diplomatic engagement to manage escalation risks.
sections.intelligence_notes: The US strike package's inclusion of air defense and coastal radar suggests preparation for sustained air superiority operations. IRGC's claimed HIMARS destruction in Kuwait, if verified, demonstrates precision targeting of mobile artillery. The 13 US tanker aircraft active indicates high-tempo aerial refueling for extended strike sorties. Monitoring for Iranian ballistic missile use against Gulf targets remains critical.
